On Saptami too thousands had thronged the pandal. “As rain hit pandal hoppers tried to take shelter inside the pandal. Those inside the pandal refused to go out. People also started to push in from the exit resulting in the chaos which ultimately the stampede started,” said a local resident. Row after Chorbagan stampede Allegations surfaced that there were not enough police at the scene, cops didn’t help the victims, there was no ambulance and locals had to book app cabs to help victims reach the hospital. "Who made these allegations? The victims, whom I spoke to at the hospital, gave a different version. They said the police helped them and booked cabs to send them to the hospital. The allegations are mainly against some home guards recruited two years back (during the previous government). Some of them don't even know Bengali and have a language barrier. I have asked for a list of the homeguards," Adhikari said. Ritesh Tiwari, state BJP spokesperson and MLA from Kolkata's Kashipur-Belgachhia constituency, defended his colleagues. "For decades, TMC MLAs and ministers such as Partha Chatterjee, Aroop Biswas and Firhad Hakim have been closely associated with community Durga Pujas. Before that, veteran Congress leader Somem Mitra was also associated with pujas. What is wrong if some BJP leaders are associated with some pujas? The chief minister has ordered a probe and the police have arrested several people," Tiwari said. - ABOUT THE AUTHOR Joydeep Thakur Joydeep Thakur is a Special Correspondent based in Kolkata. news.headline: Video captures Tiger Shroff escaping in car after assassination bid in Mumbai's Juhu
news.story_lead: Video captures Tiger Shroff escaping in car after assassination bid in Mumbai's Juhu In the purported video, filmed by a bystander, Tiger is seen hurriedly getting into the driver's seat and shutting the door before the car begins to move. Actor Tiger Shroff can be seen hurriedly moving to the driver's seat in a video purportedly showing moments after his car was attacked by three men in Mumbai on Sunday evening. In the purported video, shot by someone present at the scene, Tiger is seen quickly getting into the driver's seat and shutting the car door before the vehicle starts moving.
news.full_article_text: Video captures Tiger Shroff escaping in car after assassination bid in Mumbai's Juhu In the purported video, filmed by a bystander, Tiger is seen hurriedly getting into the driver's seat and shutting the door before the car begins to move. The video ends shortly afterwards. Also Read | Tiger Shroff escapes unhurt after shots fired at actor in Mumbai, Lawrence Bishnoi gang claims attack HT could not independently verify the video. Tiger sustained minor abrasions, Nanavati hospital sources told HT. DCP Mohit Kumar Garg said, “The incident took place at around 7:00 PM. Some unknown persons came to the location and opened fire at Mr. Tiger Shroff as he was returning after finishing his private event. Tiger Shroff did not sustain any gunshot injuries and is completely safe. Two people were injured in the incident. One of them is Mr. Firdaus, his driver, who sustained an injury to his hand.” Autorickshaw driver Umesh Chavan was taken to Cooper Hospital with a single gunshot wound to his chest, sources said, adding that he was stable, out of danger and admitted to the hospital’s surgery department. Also Read | Maharashtra CM speaks to Tiger Shroff after assassination bid, dy CM Shinde says 'no gang will be spared' Tiger’s driver sustained a gunshot injury to his left hand and may require surgery. The actor suffered minor abrasions, was examined and later discharged, according to sources at Nanavati Hospital. Mumbai Police has formed multiple teams to investigate the firing incident involving the actor. Police said all personnel and branches were working on the case, while the forensic team had conducted a preliminary analysis. Further details will be shared as more relevant information becomes available, police said. The Lawrence Bishnoi gang claimed responsibility for the attack at Tiger. In a voice note, a member of the group allegedly warned that anyone in the Mumbai film industry who refuses to heed its warnings or works with actor Salman Khan would be next. news.headline: Pope Leo XIV thanks wellwishers in first event after cancer surgery
news.story_lead: Pope Leo XIV thanks wellwishers in first event after cancer surgery Pope Leo XIV held his first public engagement since his lung cancer surgery on Sunday, as he recited the Angelus prayer from the window of Vatican's Apostolic Palace. The surgery had taken place just a few days before, after Pope Leo had been diagnosed with lung adenocarcinoma, the most common form of lung cancer. After the prayer, he thanked the people who have prayed for him in recent days and said he appreciated the support.

news.full_article_text: ‘Not enough police, govt hospital lacked facilities’: Kolkata pandal tragedy raises questions over emergency response Allegations also surfaced that the state-run hospital lacked adequate facilities to treat the victims, forcing some of them to be referred to a private hospital Sonu Ojha, a resident of Kolkata’s Chorebagan area, was chatting with two of his friends at a tea stall on Amar Basu Sarani and watching the crowd move towards the entrance of the puja pandal moments before the stampede. It was drizzling, with occasional spells of moderate rain. “We could feel that something wasn’t right. The people were anxious and getting restless to take shelter under some shade as most of them weren’t carrying umbrellas. Then we heard that a stampede has started near the exit on Bhuban Banerjee Lane. All three of us rushed to the spot and what we saw was hell,” said Ojha, 37, a tv-mechanic who has closed his shop for the puja. Also Read | 'There was no way out': Families mourn loss of loved ones in Durga Puja stampede that killed 19 Deep Dive People were still rushing out of the pandal. While some were lying on the road in unconscious state, some were ill and some gasping for breath. A few were injured and could hardly walk. “We carried a middle-aged woman on a plastic chair and took her to a cab. Her relative was with her. They rushed to the hospital and we went back to the spot to help others. There were many other locals who had started helping the victims,” he said. In a video that surfaced on social media, people could be seen carrying an unconscious young woman and rushing down the lane. “There were not enough police and organisers couldn’t be seen anywhere. It was the local residents who started the rescue operation. I helped an elderly man who had come with his grandson. I made the sit in an empty food stall and arranged water from a house. I told them to wait there till the rush was over,” said Vivek Sonkar, another resident. Also Read | Kolkata Durga Puja stampede hits BJP amid row over leaders’ role in Bengal’s puja committees Most of the victims were rushed to the Calcutta Medical College and Hospital which was around two kilometres away from the stampede spot. A junior doctor, who did not wish to be named, said injured victims and bodies were brought to the hospital in cabs and ambulances. Relatives and family members of the victims also arrived one after another. “Some of the victims were declared dead while some had fractures. Many had fallen ill due to the suffocation and pressure of crowd and stampede in the pandal,” he said. Allegations also surfaced that the state-run hospital lacked adequate facilities to treat the victims, forcing some of them to be referred to a private hospital. A section of junior doctors at Calcutta Medical College and Hospital told media persons that the hospital lacked proper trauma-care facilities, prompting the referrals. The junior doctors also said that critically injured road accident victims brought to the hospital are referred to SSKM Hospital or RG Kar Medical College and Hospital. “This is true. There is no proper facility at the CMCH for treating such trauma victims. The state health minister was seen on saying before television channels that victims would be treated at a private hospital. Several victims were referred to a private hospital on EM Bypass. This only implies that the state-run hospital can’t cater to such emergencies and disasters,” said Aniket Mahata, a prominent face of the RG Kar movement. “These are baseless allegations. Those who are making these allegations seem to be knowing everything. Why study in a medical college then? There are so many avenues. If anyone has allegations he should come and meet the authorities and raise the demands,” Sharadwat Mukhopadhyay, state health minister told the media. - ABOUT THE AUTHOR Joydeep Thakur Joydeep Thakur is a Special Correspondent based in Kolkata. He focuses on science, environment, wildlife, agriculture and other related issues.

news.headline: BJP wary as Jagan Mohan Reddy hints at shift towards INDIA bloc
news.story_lead: BJP wary as Jagan Mohan Reddy hints at shift towards INDIA bloc Senior BJP party leaders who spoke on condition of anonymity said the YSRCP joining the INDIA bloc will pave the way for a political shift not just in the state, but also in the neighbouring Telangana. The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is closely watching developments in Andhra Pradesh where former chief minister and YSR Congress Party (YSRCP) chief Jagan Mohan Reddy’s statement expressing support for the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and seeking electoral reforms is being perceived as an indication that the once “friendly party” could be moving towards the opposition bloc. Reddy on Sunday said the appointment of election commissioners should be independent of the government in power.
news.full_article_text: BJP wary as Jagan Mohan Reddy hints at shift towards INDIA bloc Senior BJP party leaders who spoke on condition of anonymity said the YSRCP joining the INDIA bloc will pave the way for a political shift not just in the state, but also in the neighbouring Telangana. The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is closely watching developments in Andhra Pradesh where former chief minister and YSR Congress Party (YSRCP) chief Jagan Mohan Reddy’s statement expressing support for the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and seeking electoral reforms is being perceived as an indication that the once “friendly party” could be moving towards the opposition bloc. Reddy on Sunday said the appointment of election commissioners should be independent of the government in power. He also expressed regret over his party’s support for the Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023, which governs the appointment of Election Commissioners in 2023. “Approving that, I am regretting it now,” Jagan said, while addressing the media. The former CM also expressed concerns over the SIR and said 4.6 million fake voters had been identified across the country, and the government had decided to proceed with the elections using an unrevised electoral roll. He alleged that the delimitation of divisions and wards had been carried out to favour the ruling National Democratic Alliance (NDA) coalition. Earlier this week, Jagan, in a post on X, said, “A proactive approach always yields better results than a reactive stance. The system has a flaw that needs to be corrected. Trust in the electoral process must be restored. The arrests of Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka do not solve anything; it only aggravates the situation. I empathise with @SauravDassss and @AshutoshRanka.” The tweet was seen as an endorsement of the CJP, which is part of the ongoing demonstrations in the Capital against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, for what they allege are irregularities in the conduct of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR). The possible realignment also comes at a time when the BJP is scouting for support for the passage of the Constitution (One Hundred and Thirty First Amendment) Bill, 2026 and the Delimitation Bill, which seeks to redraw boundaries based on the 2011 census and is necessary for implementing the 33% quotas for women in legislatures. The YSRCP has 8 MPs—four each in Rajya Sabha and the Lok Sabha. Even as it was not part of the ruling NDA, it was counted as a friendly party that supported the government on several key issues including the Citizenship Amendment Act; the abrogation of Article 370 and the farm laws. The BJP was counting on it to support the delimitation bill as well as the Constitutional Amendment bill that requires two-third majority, even though Reddy had asked the Union government to ensure that the southern states do not lose out on seats owing to better population control measures. The party had also demanded that the government’s assurance of proportionate increase in seats for southern states should be inserted in the text of the delimitation bill. The delimitation bill needs a simple majority for passage, which the NDA, with its numbers in both the Houses, can achieve—in the Lok Sabha, it has over 300 while the simple majority mark is 272 of 543 members; in the Rajya Sabha it has 153 of 245. But the ruling coalition falls short of 360 votes, required for the two-third majority in the Lower House and 164 required in the Upper House for the passage of the Constitutional Amendment Bill. On the political impact of the realignment, BJP leaders said the coming together of Reddy and the Congress in Andhra Pradesh will pose a challenge to the ruling Telugu Desam Party (TDP), a key ally of the BJP-led NDA. And in Telangana too, the BJP, will have to contest against a formidable opponent. “Of late, there have been indications that the YSRCP will join the INDIA bloc. If that were to happen then the opposition will gain support from the larger coalition of Christian and Muslim voters in AP. The percentage of Christian voters is high in AP and they support Jagan, they also have a significant presence in Telangana, which the Congress will benefit from,” said a BJP leader. In AP, Christians are 1.37% of the electorate while Muslims are a little over 9%; in Telangana Christians are 1.27%, and Muslims are a little over 12%. “However, estimates put the percentage of Christians at 10-15% in both the states, as many practising Christians who are originally Dalits continue to identify as Hindus for reservation benefits,” said the leader. Explaining the shift in votes, he said that if the YSRCP aligns with the Congress, the Reddys in Telangana too will shift alliance to CM Revanth Reddy. “There is a significant settler vote (voters who shifted from Coastal Andhra and Rayalaseema but are registered voters in Telangana) that is crucial in 20-30 constituencies in Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) region, in places such as Gachibowli, Khammam, and Suryapet, which the Congress will gain if the realignment occurs,” the leader said. However, a second party leader said Reddy’s statements came close on the heels of the CBI and the Enforcement Directorate (ED), which are probing cases against the former CM, moving the court to seek a daily trial. “This is a fight for survival. The issue of vote chori that the opposition has raised has no traction on the ground here…” the second leader said. - ABOUT THE AUTHOR Smriti Kak Ramachandran Smriti covers an intersection of politics and governance. Having spent over a decade in journalism, she combines old fashioned leg work with modern story telling tools.

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is closely watching developments in Andhra Pradesh where former chief minister and YSR Congress Party (YSRCP) chief Jagan Mohan Reddy’s statement expressing support for the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and seeking electoral reforms is being perceived as an indication that the once “friendly party” could be moving towards the opposition bloc.

Reddy on Sunday said the appointment of election commissioners should be independent of the government in power. He also expressed regret over his party’s support for the Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023, which governs the appointment of Election Commissioners in 2023.
“Approving that, I am regretting it now,” Jagan said, while addressing the media.

The former CM also expressed concerns over the SIR and said 4.6 million fake voters had been identified across the country, and the government had decided to proceed with the elections using an unrevised electoral roll. He alleged that the delimitation of divisions and wards had been carried out to favour the ruling National Democratic Alliance (NDA) coalition.

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is closely watching developments in Andhra Pradesh where former chief minister and YSR Congress Party (YSRCP) chief Jagan Mohan Reddy’s statement expressing support for the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and seeking electoral reforms is being perceived as an indication that the once “friendly party” could be moving towards the opposition bloc. Reddy on Sunday said the appointment of election commissioners should be independent of the government in power. He also expressed regret over his party’s support for the Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023, which governs the appointment of Election Commissioners in 2023. “Approving that, I am regretting it now,” Jagan said, while addressing the media. The former CM also expressed concerns over the SIR and said 4.6 million fake voters had been identified across the country, and the government had decided to proceed with the elections using an unrevised electoral roll. He alleged that the delimitation of divisions and wards had been carried out to favour the ruling National Democratic Alliance (NDA) coalition. Earlier this week, Jagan, in a post on X, said, “A proactive approach always yields better results than a reactive stance. The system has a flaw that needs to be corrected. Trust in the electoral process must be restored. The arrests of Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka do not solve anything; it only aggravates the situation. I empathise with @SauravDassss and @AshutoshRanka.” The tweet was seen as an endorsement of the CJP, which is part of the ongoing demonstrations in the Capital against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, for what they allege are irregularities in the conduct of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR). The possible realignment also comes at a time when the BJP is scouting for support for the passage of the Constitution (One Hundred and Thirty First Amendment) Bill, 2026 and the Delimitation Bill, which seeks to redraw boundaries based on the 2011 census and is necessary for implementing the 33% quotas for women in legislatures. The YSRCP has 8 MPs—four each in Rajya Sabha and the Lok Sabha. Even as it was not part of the ruling NDA, it was counted as a friendly party that supported the government on several key issues including the Citizenship Amendment Act; the abrogation of Article 370 and the farm laws. The BJP was counting on it to support the delimitation bill as well as the Constitutional Amendment bill that requires two-third majority, even though Reddy had asked the Union government to ensure that the southern states do not lose out on seats owing to better population control measures. The party had also demanded that the government’s assurance of proportionate increase in seats for southern states should be inserted in the text of the delimitation bill. The delimitation bill needs a simple majority for passage, which the NDA, with its numbers in both the Houses, can achieve—in the Lok Sabha, it has over 300 while the simple majority mark is 272 of 543 members; in the Rajya Sabha it has 153 of 245. But the ruling coalition falls short of 360 votes, required for the two-third majority in the Lower House and 164 required in the Upper House for the passage of the Constitutional Amendment Bill. On the political impact of the realignment, BJP leaders said the coming together of Reddy and the Congress in Andhra Pradesh will pose a challenge to the ruling Telugu Desam Party (TDP), a key ally of the BJP-led NDA. And in Telangana too, the BJP, will have to contest against a formidable opponent. “Of late, there have been indications that the YSRCP will join the INDIA bloc. If that were to happen then the opposition will gain support from the larger coalition of Christian and Muslim voters in AP. The percentage of Christian voters is high in AP and they support Jagan, they also have a significant presence in Telangana, which the Congress will benefit from,” said a BJP leader. In AP, Christians are 1.37% of the electorate while Muslims are a little over 9%; in Telangana Christians are 1.27%, and Muslims are a little over 12%. “However, estimates put the percentage of Christians at 10-15% in both the states, as many practising Christians who are originally Dalits continue to identify as Hindus for reservation benefits,” said the leader. Explaining the shift in votes, he said that if the YSRCP aligns with the Congress, the Reddys in Telangana too will shift alliance to CM Revanth Reddy. “There is a significant settler vote (voters who shifted from Coastal Andhra and Rayalaseema but are registered voters in Telangana) that is crucial in 20-30 constituencies in Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) region, in places such as Gachibowli, Khammam, and Suryapet, which the Congress will gain if the realignment occurs,” the leader said. However, a second party leader said Reddy’s statements came close on the heels of the CBI and the Enforcement Directorate (ED), which are probing cases against the former CM, moving the court to seek a daily trial. “This is a fight for survival. The issue of vote chori that the opposition has raised has no traction on the ground here…” the second leader said. - ABOUT THE AUTHOR Smriti Kak Ramachandran Smriti covers an intersection of politics and governance. Having spent over a decade in journalism, she combines old fashioned leg work with modern story telling tools.

### Macroeconomic Fundamentals of the Indian Economy

Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has affirmed that the core fundamentals supporting the Indian economy remain strong and resilient.

* **Core Statement:** The Finance Minister emphasized that India's underlying economic framework continues to demonstrate strength.
* **Macroeconomic Outlook:** The assertion reflects official optimism regarding India's economic stability, fiscal resilience, and sustained growth prospects.
bullet_points: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman asserted that the fundamental indicators of the Indian economy are strong.
The statement underlines macroeconomic resilience amidst domestic and global economic conditions.
Official perspectives reinforce confidence in India's structural economic growth trajectory.

news.upsc_analysis: Assessment of macroeconomic fundamentals is vital for evaluating India's growth resilience, fiscal stability, and investment potential.
impacts: Encourages investor confidence in the growth trajectory of the Indian economy.
way_forward: Continued focus on maintaining low inflation, sustainable fiscal deficit targets, and robust infrastructure investment.
news.mains_notes: Macroeconomic stability, driven by sound fiscal policy and structural fundamentals, forms the baseline for sustainable long-term economic growth in India.

hindi_translation.headline: केंद्रीय वित्त मंत्री ने भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के मजबूत बुनियादी ढांचे की पुष्टि की
hindi_translation.story_lead: केंद्रीय वित्त मंत्री निर्मला सीतारमण ने कहा है कि भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के प्रमुख बुनियादी आधार मजबूत बने हुए हैं। उनका यह बयान देश के समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र (मैक्रोइकॉनॉमिक) पथ और निरंतर स्थिरता में विश्वास को रेखांकित करता है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के समष्टि आर्थिक आधार

केंद्रीय वित्त मंत्री निर्मला सीतारमण ने पुष्टि की है कि भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था का समर्थन करने वाले मुख्य बुनियादी आधार मजबूत और लचीले बने हुए हैं।

* **मुख्य वक्तव्य:** वित्त मंत्री ने इस बात पर जोर दिया कि भारत का अंतर्निहित आर्थिक ढांचा मजबूती का प्रदर्शन जारी रखे हुए है।
* **समष्टि आर्थिक दृष्टिकोण:** यह बयान भारत की आर्थिक स्थिरता, वित्तीय लचीलेपन और निरंतर विकास की संभावनाओं के संबंध में आधिकारिक आशावाद को दर्शाता है।
bullet_points: वित्त मंत्री निर्मला सीतारमण ने कहा कि भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के मूलभूत संकेतक मजबूत हैं।
यह बयान घरेलू और वैश्विक आर्थिक परिस्थितियों के बीच समष्टि आर्थिक लचीलेपन को रेखांकित करता है।
आधिकारिक दृष्टिकोण भारत के संरचनात्मक आर्थिक विकास पथ में विश्वास को मजबूत करता है।

news.headline: CJI Inaugurates Ladakh High Court Bench and Announces Single-Day Virtual Supreme Court Hearings for the Region
news.story_lead: Chief Justice of India Justice Surya Kant has inaugurated the Ladakh Bench of the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh, establishing a dedicated judicial presence in the high-altitude region. To eliminate geographical and financial barriers for litigants and advocates, the CJI announced that all Supreme Court cases originating from Ladakh will be grouped on a single day and conducted virtually.
news.full_article_text:
### Key Judicial Infrastructure Development in Ladakh

Chief Justice of India Justice Surya Kant inaugurated the Ladakh Bench of the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh, bringing formal high court proceedings directly to the Union Territory. Situated at an elevation of roughly 3,500 metres above sea level, the bench represents the highest-altitude high court setup in India.

### Virtual Access Mechanism for Supreme Court Cases

To address the immense physical distance and financial hardship associated with traveling to New Delhi, the Supreme Court plans to implement a special virtual hearing protocol:
* **Consolidated Listing:** All legal matters originating from the Ladakh region will be grouped and listed for hearing on a single designated day.
* **Virtual Arguments:** Lawyers from the Leh and Kargil bar associations will be able to argue cases before the Supreme Court via video-conferencing directly from the Ladakh High Court bench.
* **Continuous Hearing:** The apex court will hear these listed matters on a day-to-day virtual basis until disposition.

### Historical Context and Geographical Challenges

During the event, CJI Surya Kant highlighted the long judicial history of the region, noting that a Special Court was first established in Leh in 1870. Following the creation of the Union Territory of Ladakh in 2019, 'Ladakh' was officially added to the title of the High Court. However, winter connectivity issues across the Great Himalayas historically forced litigants to rely almost exclusively on air travel to access high court benches.

### Strengthening Legal Aid and Local Dispute Resolution

CJI Kant stressed that technology and legal aid serve as crucial tools for judicial inclusion. Key initiatives outlined include:
* Active involvement of the Ladakh Legal Services Authority and the court's Legal Services Committee.
* Utilization of para-legal volunteers, legal awareness camps, and Lok Adalats to resolve grievances at the grassroots level.
* Recognition of traditional community dispute resolution mechanisms and village institutions that have long functioned in the region.
news.background_context: A Special Court was established in Leh in 1870. Following the reorganisation of the state into Union Territories in 2019, 'Ladakh' was formally incorporated into the official title of the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh. Prior to this, accessing the high court involved severe winter travel constraints across the Great Himalayas.
bullet_points: CJI Justice Surya Kant inaugurated the Ladakh Bench of the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh.
The bench is located at an altitude of approximately 3,500 metres, making it the highest sitting high court bench in India.
All Supreme Court cases from Ladakh will be listed on a single designated day for virtual proceedings.
Lawyers from Leh and Kargil will be allowed to present arguments before the Supreme Court without traveling to Delhi.
The initiative aims to save time, reduce expenses, and eliminate geographical travel hurdles for litigants in remote regions.
A Special Court was originally set up in Leh in 1870, establishing a long tradition of legal administration in the district.
The name 'Ladakh' was added to the Jammu and Kashmir High Court after the creation of the Union Territory in 2019.
Legal aid mechanisms including Lok Adalats, para-legal volunteers, and legal awareness camps will be strengthened across Leh and Kargil.
key_facts: High Court Bench location: Ladakh (serving Leh and Kargil districts).
Elevation of the court setup: Approximately 3,500 metres above sea level.

UPSC Mains: GS Paper II - Structure, Organization and Functioning of the Judiciary; Issues relating to Access to Justice and E-Governance in Courts.
news.upsc_analysis: The establishment of the Ladakh Bench and single-day virtual hearing protocols at the Supreme Court level highlights the role of technology in expanding access to justice in remote border regions. By addressing severe geographical obstacles, such steps fulfill the constitutional mandate under Article 39A and demonstrate how digital court infrastructure can bridge distance and financial constraints for marginalized populations.
causes: Geographical isolation and severe winter transportation challenges across the Great Himalayas made travel to Delhi or main high court benches costly and difficult.
Need to operationalize full judicial access for residents of Leh and Kargil following the 2019 creation of the Union Territory of Ladakh.
impacts: Litigants and advocates from Leh and Kargil save substantial time and money by avoiding long-distance travel to New Delhi.
Enhanced local legal ownership and improved reach of legal aid services, Lok Adalats, and crime victim compensation schemes.
challenges: Maintaining reliable telecommunications and video-conferencing infrastructure at high altitudes (3,500 metres).
Ensuring equitable reach of legal awareness and services across remote areas like Nubra.

constitutional_or_policy_link: Article 39A: Directive Principle of State Policy promoting equal justice and free legal aid.
Article 214 & Article 231: Provisions relating to High Courts for States and common High Courts for two or more States/Union Territories.
way_forward: Ensure robust high-speed internet connectivity and digital court infrastructure across high-altitude districts.
Strengthen para-legal volunteer networks to reach citizens in far-flung rural and border villages.
news.mains_notes: Judicial decentralization through e-courts and high-altitude benches serves as an effective tool for social inclusion. Combining regional high court benches with dedicated virtual hearing days at the Supreme Court minimizes geographical disadvantages, supporting the principles of Article 39A (Equal Justice and Free Legal Aid). Integrating traditional community dispute mechanisms with formal legal services further ensures swift dispute resolution.

hindi_translation.headline: सीजेआई ने लद्दाख उच्च न्यायालय पीठ का उद्घाटन किया; लेह और कारगिल के वकीलों के लिए वर्चुअल सुप्रीम कोर्ट सुनवाई की घोषणा की
hindi_translation.story_lead: भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश जस्टिस सूर्य कांत ने जम्मू और कश्मीर तथा लद्दाख उच्च न्यायालय की लद्दाख पीठ का उद्घाटन किया, जिससे इस उच्च पर्वतीय क्षेत्र में एक समर्पित न्यायिक उपस्थिति स्थापित हुई है। दूरस्थ भौगोलिक स्थिति और वित्तीय बाधाओं को समाप्त करने के लिए सीजेआई ने घोषणा की कि लद्दाख से संबंधित सभी मामलों को एक ही दिन सूचीबद्ध करके सुप्रीम कोर्ट में वर्चुअल तरीके से सुना जाएगा।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### लद्दाख में प्रमुख न्यायिक बुनियादी ढांचे का विकास

भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश जस्टिस सूर्य कांत ने जम्मू और कश्मीर तथा लद्दाख उच्च न्यायालय की लद्दाख पीठ का उद्घाटन किया, जिससे केंद्र शासित प्रदेश को सीधे उच्च न्यायालय की कार्यवाही की सुविधा मिल सकेगी। समुद्र तल से लगभग 3,500 मीटर की ऊंचाई पर स्थित यह पीठ भारत में सबसे अधिक ऊंचाई पर स्थित उच्च न्यायालय की पीठ है।

### उच्चतम न्यायालय के मामलों के लिए वर्चुअल पहुंच तंत्र

नई दिल्ली की यात्रा से जुड़े भारी समय और वित्तीय कठिनाइयों को दूर करने के लिए उच्चतम न्यायालय एक विशेष वर्चुअल सुनवाई व्यवस्था लागू करेगा:
* **समेकित सूचीबद्धता:** लद्दाख क्षेत्र से उत्पन्न होने वाले सभी कानूनी मामलों को एक ही निश्चित दिन पर सुनवाई के लिए सूचीबद्ध किया जाएगा।
* **वर्चुअल बहस:** लेह और कारगिल बार एसोसिएशन के वकील सीधे लद्दाख उच्च न्यायालय पीठ से वीडियो कॉन्फ्रेंसिंग के माध्यम से सुप्रीम कोर्ट के समक्ष मामले पेश कर सकेंगे।
* **सतत सुनवाई:** शीर्ष अदालत इन मामलों को निपटारे तक प्रतिदिन वर्चुअल आधार पर सुनेगी।

### ऐतिहासिक संदर्भ और भौगोलिक चुनौतियाँ

कार्यक्रम के दौरान सीजेआई सूर्य कांत ने क्षेत्र के लंबे न्यायिक इतिहास का उल्लेख करते हुए बताया कि 1870 में लेह में एक विशेष अदालत की स्थापना की गई थी। 2019 में लद्दाख के केंद्र शासित प्रदेश बनने के बाद उच्च न्यायालय के नाम में 'लद्दाख' जोड़ा गया था। हालाँकि, सर्दियों में महान हिमालयी क्षेत्र के कारण केवल हवाई यात्रा ही एकमात्र माध्यम रह जाती थी।

### कानूनी सहायता और स्थानीय विवाद समाधान को सुदृढ़ बनाना

सीजेआई कांत ने जोर देकर कहा कि तकनीक और कानूनी सहायता न्यायिक समावेश के आवश्यक साधन हैं। प्रमुख पहलों में शामिल हैं:
* लद्दाख कानूनी सेवा प्राधिकरण और अदालत की कानूनी सेवा समिति की सक्रिय भागीदारी।
* पैरा-लीगल स्वयंसेवकों, कानूनी जागरूकता शिविरों और लोक अदालतों के माध्यम से जमीनी स्तर पर शिकायतों का निवारण।
* क्षेत्र में लंबे समय से काम कर रही पारंपरिक सामुदायिक विवाद समाधान प्रणालियों और ग्रामीण संस्थाओं को मान्यता देना।
hindi_translation.background_context: 1870 में लेह में एक विशेष अदालत स्थापित की गई थी। 2019 में केंद्र शासित प्रदेश बनने के बाद उच्च न्यायालय के आधिकारिक नाम में 'लद्दाख' जोड़ा गया था। इससे पहले, सर्दियों में कनेक्टिविटी की समस्याओं के कारण उच्च न्यायालय तक पहुंचना कठिन होता था।
bullet_points: सीजेआई जस्टिस सूर्य कांत ने जम्मू और कश्मीर तथा लद्दाख उच्च न्यायालय की लद्दाख पीठ का उद्घाटन किया।
यह पीठ लगभग 3,500 मीटर की ऊंचाई पर स्थित है, जो भारत में सबसे ऊंची उच्च न्यायालय पीठ है।
लद्दाख से संबंधित सभी सुप्रीम कोर्ट मामलों को एक ही दिन वर्चुअल सुनवाई के लिए सूचीबद्ध किया जाएगा।
लेह और कारगिल के वकीलों को दिल्ली यात्रा किए बिना सुप्रीम कोर्ट में बहस करने की अनुमति मिलेगी।
इस पहल का उद्देश्य दूरस्थ क्षेत्रों के मुकदमों के लिए समय, खर्च और यात्रा की कठिनाइयों को कम करना है।
1870 में लेह में पहली बार एक विशेष अदालत स्थापित की गई थी।
2019 में केंद्र शासित प्रदेश बनने के बाद जम्मू-कश्मीर उच्च न्यायालय के नाम में 'लद्दाख' जोड़ा गया।
लेह और कारगिल में लोक अदालतों और कानूनी सहायता तंत्र को मजबूत किया जाएगा।
key_facts: उच्च न्यायालय पीठ का स्थान: लद्दाख (लेह और कारगिल जिले)।

quiz.question: Regarding the recently inaugurated Ladakh Bench of the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh, which of the following statements is correct?

quiz.correct_answer: A) It is situated at an elevation of approximately 3,500 metres, making it the highest sitting high court bench in India.
quiz.explanation: CJI Justice Surya Kant noted that the Ladakh Bench sits at an elevation of around 3,500 metres above sea level, making it the highest sitting high court bench in India. The Supreme Court will also facilitate virtual proceedings for Ladakh matters on a single designated day.
